description: Header file defining Vulkan command buffer and command pool classes for GPU command management in a Vulkan API wrapper within the ATen library.

classes.name: CommandBuffer
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan command buffer with methods for recording and submitting GPU commands.

classes.name: CommandPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of Vulkan command buffers for efficient reuse.

classes.name: CommandPoolConfig
classes.description: Configuration parameters for initializing a CommandPool.

methods.name: CommandBuffer::begin
methods.description: Begins recording commands into the command buffer.

methods.name: CommandBuffer::end
methods.description: Ends recording commands into the command buffer.

methods.name: CommandBuffer::bind_pipeline
methods.description: Binds a pipeline and layout to the command buffer.

methods.name: CommandBuffer::bind_descriptors
methods.description: Binds descriptor sets to the command buffer.

methods.name: CommandBuffer::insert_barrier
methods.description: Inserts a pipeline barrier for synchronization.

methods.name: CommandBuffer::copy_texture_to_buffer
methods.description: Copies data from texture to buffer.

methods.name: CommandBuffer::copy_buffer_to_texture
methods.description: Copies data from buffer to texture.

methods.name: CommandBuffer::write_timestamp
methods.description: Writes a timestamp to a query pool.

methods.name: CommandBuffer::reset_querypool
methods.description: Resets a range of queries in a query pool.

methods.name: CommandBuffer::get_submit_handle
methods.description: Returns the Vulkan handle for submission.

methods.name: CommandPool::get_new_cmd
methods.description: Allocates a new command buffer from the pool.

methods.name: CommandPool::flush
methods.description: Flushes the command pool, possibly submitting all command buffers.
